notes: R turns a whole stack. Select the bottom case of a stack (or several cases) and R turns them all a quarter turn together, still stacked and lined up, instead of having to unstack, turn each one and restack. ⌘Z takes it back in one go. Turning and tipping find room. R and T turn a case around its middle at its own height, never up onto a neighbour, and shuffle it over up to 2 feet to fit: a tipped 200 goes back on its wheels in the gap it has, and a nearly square case (24 × 23½) wedged between others turns instead of being refused.
